description: Portfolio holdings for a fund at a point in time, largest position first. Values are US dollars; weightPercent is percent of portfolio.

as_of.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the latest snapshot on or before this date. Omit for the most recent.

available_as_of.description: Lookahead guard (YYYY-MM-DD): only consider filings actually published by this date. Use for backtests.

name: get_holdings
